summary: Codex capture is deliberately ONE-SHOT v5, not the trigger machine: Codex's Stop fires once at session exit (TUI) or by construction (codex exec), so there is nothing to time and no next prompt for pending delivery — blocking {decision:block} at the single Stop, with a session-cumulative offered-set marker for resumed threads. Updating shipped hook files changes their hash, so Codex re-prompts its trust gate once after every coldstart update. LIVE-UNTESTED as of 2.2.0.
